title: Form 1125-A, Cost of Goods Sold (Rev. November 2024), with instructions

passages.question: Is Form 1125-A required, and which revision?
passages.excerpt: Filers of Form 1120, 1120-C, 1120-F, 1120S, or 1065 must complete and attach Form 1125-A if the applicable entity reports a deduction for cost of goods sold.

passages.question: How is Form 1125-A line 9e answered on section 263A?
passages.excerpt: A small business taxpayer is not required to capitalize costs under section 263A. See section 263A(i).
